name: You
description: A traveller with a good pair of boots.

name: Reeve Odda
description: She keeps the village tally on a notched stick she never puts down.

name: Steward Brannoc
description: He holds the keep while its lord rides the border.

name: Hild the chandler
description: Her stall under the bridge sells everything from rope to barley.

name: Maddoc the wool factor
description: He weighs every bale twice and trusts neither weighing.

name: Old Wenna
description: A storyteller who sleeps wherever the last tale ran out.

name: The fen outlaws
description: Reed-cutters turned robbers, camped where the causeway meets the dry ground.

name: Warden Cadoc
description: The keep's men in green, sent down the fen road as the steward promised.
